nom: Clinique All About Clean 2-in-1 Charcoal Face Mask + Scrub

avis.texte: Cleans and scrubs oily rough skin. Need to moisturize a lot after using charcoal mask. Definitely not for drier skin types. Bring back creamy blue clay mask. Stop discontinuing wonderful products. Why fix what not broken
This mask does not compare to the clay mask. Mediocre at best, the clay mask deep cleaned pores so much better and brightened skin

avis.titre: Wish bring the old clay mask back
avis.texte: Miss the clay mask. Really do not need the scrub factor. Does it leave skin softer? Yes. Pores look the same. Just need mask for pores.
I recently bought this on sale and just tried it for the first time tonight. Skin is clean, tight, and refined. Very pleased with the results!
The grains are very fine. I use it as a mask. Best to use in the shower, because grains are difficult to remove.

I have used this product for years and try other masks but keep coming back to this as it does not overdry but rather calms and heals bad breakouts. I have normal skin but sometimes due to diet break out and this balances out my skin. Great for spot use or overall face mask.

When I have a breakout this calms my skin and promotes healing. I try other masks but for my normal skin, I keep coming back to this because it works. It is not overdrying and there is somerhing in it that actually heals the breakouts.

avis.titre: My skin is fighting for its life
avis.texte: I used this and it literally looks like i have an incurable disease. My skin has NEVER looked this way. Even as a pre teen. PLEASE do your research on this before buying. Im too embarrassed to go out in public.

avis.titre: Bring back the old clay mask
avis.texte: I used to love the original clay mask before this. I switched to this and it does not compare. All of your tried and true products keep getting discontinued. I have been a Clinique customer for over 20 years and I am for the first time not recommending your products.

avis.titre: I absolutely love this product and have for years!
avis.texte: This is a product I always have in my routine. I don't Usually buy Clinique products, but Years ago, when I was looking for a face scrub, I found this. I had oily and acne prone skin at the time. While the oily skin is no longer an issue, it's still fantastic.
Excellent product. After use, the skin is well cleaned. I like it

This product dried so fast I wasn't able to spread it down to my neck as it dried immediately. Was told it did not have the granules in it as you don't need that with a mask, too much exfoliation. But it does have the granules. Prefer the acne solutions cleansing mask, which was very creamy and worked so well! Please bring that product back. Stop discontinuing products
I really liked that the product can be used as a scrub and a mask. It cleanses the skin very well, after use there is a feeling of cleanliness. Ideal for my combination skin.
I like this scrub a lot. Physical exfoliation plus charcoal mask to clear pores.

This is one of the best mud masks on the market. I use it for a mud mask as well as a face wash before shaving my face. It only receives four stars due to the small size, it should come in a larger size, let us say 6 oz. or 10 oz would be perfect.

I cannot tell you how many masks I have tried over the years, this one by far takes the cake it cleans deep and after a few minutes you wash it and it scrubs your face leaving it so soft and radiant I've even bought for my mom and daughter and they both love it I have it set for auto ship because this is a new part of my facial routine and I won't go without it!
This product is the best! It makes my face feel real smooth.

(I'm 13 yrs old & have been dealing with chronic acne for abt 4 years) I have the most clogged nose, chin, and nose bridge pores known to man. I have pretty normal skin so i only leave it on for abt 5 minutes. It is so good at unclogging pores. Just after one use my super-clogged pores have almost no gunk at all. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT!!!

Clinique's cleverly-concocted 2-in-1 mask is double trouble for oily skin! As a clay-based facial product, it deeply-draws out impurities and leaves behind a toned and immaculately-clear surface, but not before its bamboo-powdered partner against grime gently-but thoroughly!-exfoliates and refines skin to a silky smooth texture. With this dynamic duo in a single fantastic formula, complexion perfection is just one tube away!

avis.titre: I love this product and use it as a cleansing mask
avis.texte: I love this product and use it as a cleansing mask. I have combination skin, the mask helps the skin feel fresh
After using this mask, toner and moisturize, my skin feels so soft
If you tend to acne, blackhead and oil skin, you're gonna love this producto, I love the sensation in my skin after its use.

I tried this and was blown away by how great it is. I have very sensitive skin and use it once daily, about a dime size amount. It doesn't take much. It leaves my face so smooth with zero redness or irritation. I used to use the 7 Day Scrub but this cleanser/mask is so much better! I now have it on subscription so I never am without it. For me, it's the best cleanser Clinique has ever made. I highly recommend it. Would love a travel size!

avis.titre: Why are there no instructions on samples?
avis.texte: I said yes, but really do not know since this is the first time using the product. Just venting that the trial size products do not have instructions on the tube. I'm this case, there is room. I had no idea I should cleanse my fast first, nor did it say to leave it on for 5 mins. Argh.
very surprised how much i like this mask skin feels smoother/looks brighter
Minimize pores, purify pores, and remove excess oil and blackheads, great product

This mask is AMAZING! I only use it twice a week, but after a few times, I noticed such a difference. My skin was clear and smooth my pores were barely visible. Worth the price! The instructions say to leave it on for 5 minutes, but leave it on for about 20 minutes, until the mask turns light grey.

avis.titre: Bring Back the Discontinued Pore Refining Charcoal Mask!!!
avis.texte: This charcoal mask is nothing like the discontinued pore refining solutions version!!! I have sensitive skin with broken capillaries on my cheeks (not rosacea from a car accident) that become extremely visible and angry after using this 2-in-1 mask. Please, please, please bring back the pore refining solutions charcoal mask!!!!
I would definitely recommend this product. It's great for cleansing and exfoliating!
This is the only washable mask I love. Feels good, not heavy, and you can clearly see the results after a couple uses. 100% recommended
Love this. Made my husband do it with me! ❤❤ skin feels so nice after.

I loved the charcoal mask that Clinique had for many years before this one. I thought I would try this when they discontinued, as so often happens with Clinique, the one I always used. I have moderate rosacea, so I have enlarged pores on my checks, nose, and forehead. The previous product worked well to detoxify and minimize my pores without being too harsh, causing additional trauma to my skin, or increasing redness. This new product is a physical exfoliant which means the gritty pieces scratched my skin and exacerbated my rosacea. Very disappointing that Clinique is slowly phasing out products that target people with sensitive skin types or other skin issues such as rosacea; they used to be my go-to for their redness solutions and range of sensitive skin friendly products...
A small amount of this mask applied evenly is enough to scrub the whole face after. Smoothens by sweeping away dead skin. Twice a week nightly results in a polished, cleaner and clearer face.

I was using another charcoal face mask for years and they discontinued it. I have been searching for over a year to find a suitable replacement and this is it - finally! It makes my skin look smoother and my pores look smaller, all without leaving my skin too oily or too dry. The search is over.

I love this mask and scrub. I use it primarily as a scrub and it exfoliates and resurfaces my face very well, leaves my face feeling clean with no break outs. The only thing is it stains my light colored wash cloths grayish. I bought a black cloth to use with this product.

I needed a new mask to replace one that was discontinued and decided to give this one a try. I use it once a week with great results! I like to put it on and then jump in the shower to shave my legs while it dries. Then I apply water and use as a gentle scrub before I rinse it off with my facecloth. It helps with blackheads and large pores. I highly recommend!

This mask is my new favorite mask! It helps clear up my skin and makes it super soft! And I really like that it is easy to apply and easy to rinse off! My skin is sensitive, dry combination, and it works wonders!
I got this for free from Ulta and I have to say I LOVE this mask. It makes my skin feel fabulous.
I have been using the 2 in 1 Charcoal Mask Scrub and i've visibly noticed a difference in my skins texture, Im really enjoying my results!
I saw the difference with the 1st try. I was hesitant to buy not knowing too much about clay masks, but I am happy I bought it.
I enjoy doing this mask about once a week. I leave it on for about 5 minutes then I hop into the shower and rinse it off. It does a nice job giving a gentle exfoliation without being drying.

It's mild for a charcoal cleanser. It really works, gets the clogged pores out. Your face feels so clean. Clinique has a wonderful product. I'm checking out other products just because of this one. The price is right also.

Just got this today and used it for the first time. Awesome product as well. I love it as it really softens the skin. It also tightens the face which I love as well. Will definitely buy again with all my other skin care and make-up from Clinique.

I had to quit using Origins Charcoal Mask since I'm allergic to Propylene Glycol ingredient in it. Had patch test at derm doctor. This really cleans my face especially nose. Glad it doesn't have a scent perfume. I'm dry but blackheads on nose are deep. Have trouble with tight pores.

I love the cleansing effect of this clay mask. I have combination skin, so I use this mask once a week all over my face, but I occasionally use it on my T-zone more often. Highly recommend it to anyone who prefer clay masks! It is a refreshing treatment!
Super cool and awesome product. Every time used loved my skin about how it leaves your skin clean and hydrated.
This product has worked effectively in removing my pores and making my face shine free. My skin is dewy and silky smooth without shine

avis.titre: St Ives Apricot Scrub is more effective.
avis.texte: This was a waste of money. 2 stars because I didn't have a reaction, I just didn't notice any benefit either. I have St Ives Apricot Scrub and notice more of a difference with that, than this. I've used the men's Clinique scrub and like it better than the apricot scrub and had hoped this would be equivalent. I'd tried the women's scrub before and didn't like it, not enough scrubbing action, well this stuff is identical. The men's has more scrub to it.

This is for people looking for a "true" clean out the pores mask. I no longer have oily skin in my older years but still have some problem areas, particularly the entire nose area. I put this mask all over my face including the jawline but avoided the neck area. This gave a very deep purification without irritating my skin in the least. Just one warning: use a dark washcloth if you use one. I used a lighter colored one and it got permanently stained. This mask is the real deal. Another hit by Clinique.

avis.titre: Easy to remove, doesn't make my sink black
avis.texte: Great product! It's easy to remove (just water will do), and it doesn't leave my sink or bathtub black. I would only use enough to go on whatever area you're applying it to. I generally put enough moisturizer on my fingers to do my whole face, but the mask will dry out if you don't apply it quickly. I use it weekly, sometimes on my whole face and sometimes just in my T-zone. I've used Clinique products for over 10 years and am just starting to buy for myself, and this is another product I love.

I've been using Clinique products for years, and nothing truly helped my oily skin long. However this stuff is a miracle worker. I used it has a mask and left it on for about 10-15 mins, then wash it off. Came off very easy with water. 24 hours later and my skin didn't get oily, very surprised! Love anything about it and will continue to use this weekly. I will say that directly after, my skin did look a little dull but after I moisturized my skin was fine. But I took a star off for it. Thankfully the dullness didn't come back the next day. Finally something that works and controls my oily skin.
Makes skin feel smooth yet gentle enough that it doesn't irritate my skin
When I used this product, it broke my face out! I am 71 years old, and haven't had zits in years. Have no idea why this happened. I have never had a problem with any Clinique product.
this is one the most effective product i ever used.you can see the result from the first use.I totally recommend this product!

avis.titre: Don't listen to the slow people giving bad reviews
avis.texte: Think about it for a second. Why would a brand have two products called "2 in 1 charcoal mask + scrub". If you bought this thinking it was different than the City Block mask; that's on you!!! Like cmon use your brain. It has the same ingredients, they just rebranded it. As far as the mask, it's amazing. Pulls everything out of my pores without being too intense or drying. The built in scrub makes sure you get everything off and it isn't hard to wash off like many other clay masks. Ive bought this so many times and will continue to do so.

avis.titre: Same as the city block purifying
avis.texte: This is the same thing, just different packaging. What happened to the other charcoal mask? Please bring back the charcoal mask without scrub and the city block purifying powder - Those were my favorites :(
This product can effectively clean the pores on my skin. I use it once a week for deep cleansing and it's one of the best cleansing masks I've ever used.
I use this mask twice a week, and I've noticed that my face feels really fresh and clean after using it. It really clears up my pores.

avis.titre: Exact same product as City Block version.
avis.texte: I've been using Clinique for over 35 years, and like trying new items when they come out. I'm feeling a bit duped by this purchase however, because this seems to be the exact same product as their City Block Charcoal mask/ scrub, put into more eco friendly packaging. I already had a full tube of the previous one, so I tried them side by side, and could not tell any difference in the two. I am very annoyed that they're passing it off as something new and different, and feel like they were being more manipulative, and less than honest. The product works, but I'm only giving 2 stars for the sly marketing.

avis.titre: OUTSTANDING mask esp for sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I really loved cliniques city block purifying charcoal mask which seems as of recently is no longer available per a pop up in my favorites stating no longer available which was odd because it was a highly purchased and 5 star reviewed mask. Then on my for you showed up this Clinque all about clean 2 in 1 as a new arrival and has the exact same ingredients from what I can see as their city block purify mask/scrub which is also a 5 minute wash off and has natural bamboo charcoal and kaolin clay in it! So I am wondering if they've remarketed and labeled to show no fragrance and stating all about clean ingredients. It's an outstanding mask for acne prone, sensitive and even mature skin for breakouts. Clears congestion, reduced appearance of pores, not drying at all nor did it irritate my sensitive skin and gave a nice clean feeling. I applied and when it dried and turned blue I washed in small circles to exfoliate with cold water and my face always felt great afterwards and the tube lasted me a while as I would use 2 or 3 times weekly. Def worth the purchase.
